description.value:
Install: Hospital
Cost: 2,000eb
Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

Paired Cyberlegs with 2 Option Slots. On their turn, using their Action or Move Action, the user can deploy Stabilizers, anchoring themselves to the surface they are standing on. While anchored:
The user's MOVE becomes 0 and they cannot dodge Ranged attacks.
The user cannot be knocked Prone or be subject to any form of forced movement.
The User may wield weapons as if they have BODY 14.
The user counts as Cover for one adjacent ally taking cover directly behind them.
Releasing the stabilizers costs an Action.

Type: Cyberleg (Foundational)
Option Slots: provides 2

Foundry notes:

  • One item is the pair of legs: install it once. Its 2 slots are the 2 option slots of each leg, so a paired option uses one of them.
  • The Stabilizers are not automated.

From Bontari Homebrew Cyberpunk Items by Bontari (Cyberware).
